Anna (Partnerships): Quick sync — we need to coordinate a joint announcement + marketplace listing for the LangChain connector + LlamaIndex adapter + Gateway plugin with SigmaAccel (HW partner). Main goals: marketplace asset, joint demo, SI enablement kit. Who can own the announcement assets and timeline?
Mike (Product): I can own the announcement assets (copy + tech bullets). Need a list of required assets from marketing/legal. Target date?
Jules (Solutions): I can run the demo and build the demo script. Need a canonical dataset and a short sequence of calls (chat -> retrieval -> tool call). Can someone drop the sample dataset?
Sara (PM): Proposed target announcement Monday 2024-06-17 to align with SigmaAccel's channel webinar. Marketing wants final copy by Thu 6/13. Legal needs a partner signoff doc — @Anna can you loop them in?
Anna (Partnerships): Yes, I'll ping legal and marketing. I'll also ask SigmaAccel for a short quote and approved logo. Assigning: Mike = assets, Jules = demo, Ravi = perf & infra checklist, me = partner coordination + blog outline.
Ravi (Eng): Heads up on infra — Dedicated pools currently close to capacity that week. For demo we should use a quantized 4-bit variant and a cache warmup. Perf baseline commands I ran locally: `./bench --model rwd-kernel-v2-q4 --seq 1024 --batch 8 --warmup 200` — expect ~45ms/token on our dev rig. If we need lower latency, we should route demo traffic to Dedicated or use our small-seq optimized kernel.
Jules (Solutions): Good call on cache warmup. For the demo script I'll include a step to pre-warm with the retrieval prefix. Also will build a fallback path to a smaller model if latency spikes.
Mike (Product): Marketing asset checklist (initial): 1) 1-paragraph TL;DR, 2) tech bullets (integration points: LangChain connector, LlamaIndex indexer, Gateway plugin), 3) joint quote, 4) demo video (3-4min), 5) marketplace tile + screenshots, 6) SI enablement one-pager.
Anna (Partnerships): integrations-bot created the shared doc: <https://drive.google.com/s/drive/folders/0AEXAMPLE>. Please add deliverable due dates there. Can everyone drop their preliminary items by EOD Wed? :thumbsup:
integrations-bot: Document created: "marketplace-langchain-sigmaaccel - assets & timeline" — access: anyone with link (edit).
Sara (PM): I'll coordinate the webinar slot with SigmaAccel and confirm Monday 6/17 is ok. If not, fallback week is 6/24.
Ravi (Eng): One more infra note — for the marketplace listing we need a small perf report (p95 latency, throughput for 512/1024 seq). I'll produce those numbers by Tue and attach to the doc.
Jules (Solutions): I'll prototype the demo script today and post a short runbook (commands + expected output).
Mike (Product): Thanks — I'll draft the announcement copy after I see Jules' demo and Ravi's perf numbers.
Anna (Partnerships): Great. Quick owners recap: Mike (assets+copy), Jules (demo+video), Ravi (perf report+infra), Sara (webinar slot), Anna (partner comms+legal). Check the shared doc and ping if blocked.
Jules (Solutions): Heard. Will post demo checklist in the doc by EOD.
Ravi (Eng): Will attach perf logs and the bench command outputs to the doc.
Anna (Partnerships): Perfect — closing this thread. If anything blocks, mention @Anna. :rocket:
